description: This is a detailed general arrangement drawing of a steering system for a vessel. It includes multiple views: a perspective view, detailed sections (A, B, C, D, E), a plan view, and a table listing parts and descriptions. The drawing shows the complex interconnection of rudders, bearings, tie rods, autopilot rams, and steering sheaves within the hull structure. Important details include the upper and lower bearing structures, partition placement, and the specific lengths and angles required for the toe-in and Ackermann steering effect.
